text: Implemented low-dimensional small-strain vector modes as scalar trigonometric modes times three polarizations, followed by a fixed weighted geometry-only projection out of the selected global pose space. Rigid gauge removes 6 translation/rotation fields; affine gauge removes all 12 translation/rotation/symmetric-strain fields. Projection compilation is rank revealing and records scalar basis, fixed gauge, pose kind, pivot, extension and units; transformed derivative bounds include the removed affine field. Added map/JVP/VJP and retraction for rigid and affine global pose plus field. Added quadrature-built magnitude, symmetric-strain, divergence and bending Gram terms with strictly positive magnitude precision. Semantics explicitly state geometric regularization, not tissue mechanics, and preserve local expansion/contraction. Independent tests cover rigid and affine point finite differences, JVP/VJP adjoint identity, exact weighted gauge orthogonality, nonzero local divergence, prior value/gradient/curvature finite differences, and sampled derivative bounds. Gates: JVM SmallStrainModelSuite 5/5; Scala.js 5/5; strict Werror compile and git diff --check clean. Hashes: SmallStrainModel.scala d7b9ea6556e970ad8d32f796cb60ab35e2a36d9af9b478b83cad7a9be80b19a1; SmallStrainModelSuite.scala a2c70d261f58edab2fe259fd25e14c6affd793e4bf402d2de66effa5da2eb82d. Numerical evidence is implementation correctness, not anatomical accuracy.
